scheme_name: Grant In Aid To Old Age Home
other_conditions: Applicant must be a registered Non‑Governmental Organization (NGO).
The NGO must only accommodate old, destitute, or disabled victims.
Old men must be at least 60 years old; old women must be at least 55 years old.
Beneficiaries must be citizens of India and permanent residents of Maharashtra.
benefits_summary: Grants are provided to NGOs to support old men, women, destitute and disabled persons with food, accommodation, lodging, boarding and medical assistance in old age homes.
documents_required: Hard copy of the application form format obtained from the District Social Welfare Office
